entries.test: Whether any robotaxi or similar commercial service that needs remote-operator help about as often as Cruise reportedly did (every few miles) has reported operating at a profit.
entries.note: Marcus says this in his own voice, building on Brooks's point. It is a firm claim that something is impossible, so only a counterexample could settle it.

entries.test: Compare Cruise's public descriptions of its vehicles as autonomous with the remote-assistance rates and staffing later disclosed by Cruise, its CEO, or investigators.
entries.note: Conditional and hedged ('don't seem', the asterisk), but there is a plain reading. Vogt's same-day reply partly confirmed the intervention rates.
